messages:
Anita (Support): Heads up — we're getting multiple reports of 502/timeout errors and auth failures for hosted inference in us-west-2c. Customer threads show intermittent 502s and some token exchange 500s. Any oncall/infra folks available?

Maya (Oncall Ops): I'm oncall. Are errors purely 5xx or do you see latency/retransmits too?

Anita (Support): Both. Support thread from Acme shows curl requests that hit a 502 after ~6s. Token validation sometimes returns 500 with 'upstream read timeout'. They also mentioned some billing spikes around the same time.

Sam (Acme - Customer): repro steps I used:
curl -v https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
Sometimes returns 502 gateway timeout. Client logs show ECONNRESET + TLS handshake timeouts intermittently.

Devon (NetInfra): running some checks from our edge in us-west-2a -> us-west-2c. Seeing packet loss and RTT variance on a mid-hop. Posting traceroute snippet: 
```
traceroute to api.redwood.com (10.23.45.67), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.45 ms
 2  100.64.1.1  0.80 ms
 3  * * *
 4  198.51.100.14  12.3 ms  (30% loss)
 5  203.0.113.10  15.1 ms  (35% loss)
 6  10.23.45.67  16.0 ms  (40% loss)
```
Looks like an upstream hop is dropping packets. AS path is asymmetric via provider-X. Opening provider ticket now.

Chris (SRE): I see a sharp spike in 502s from our gateway fleet in us-west-2c starting ~1769854200. If the upstream is dropping, a restart won't help. Immediate plan: drain us-west-2c from the host pool and steer traffic to 2a/2b. Will apply traffic steering and enable short retries.

Maya (Oncall Ops): Applying routing changes now — setting us-west-2c weight=0 for the hosted-api pool. Warning: cache/KV miss rate will spike for some customers and latency will increase for affected sessions.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-1769854321 created — P1. Notifying network, SRE, and oncall.

Anita (Support): Posting customer-facing status update: 'Investigating elevated 5xx/timeouts in US-WEST-2C affecting hosted inference. Engineering investigating; workaround: retry with exponential backoff and/or pin to region us-west-2a until further notice.'

Blake (Platform Eng): We're also seeing OIDC introspection timeouts at the gateway when calling our auth provider (those upstream calls are timing out, causing 5xx). Short-term mitigation: increase local token cache TTL and fallback to cached validation for TTL <= 30s. Deploying change to gateway config.

Sam (Acme - Customer): Confirmed that overriding to us-west-2a reduced 5xx rate significantly. Here's a debug snippet from my curl response:
```
> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.com
> Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME
> Content-Type: application/json

< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< Date: Tue, 12 Mar 2026 19:12:09 GMT
< Content-Type: application/json
< Content-Length: 78
< Connection: keep-alive
```

Devon (NetInfra): Provider ticket #PROV-9082 opened. Provider reports partial peering flaps and is investigating BGP adjacencies on their transit. ETA for mitigation ~30m.

Chris (SRE): Mitigation checklist executed:
1) Drain us-west-2c from hosted-api pool
2) Increase gateway retry logic (short retrys with jitter)
3) Increase auth cache TTL and enable local fallback for OIDC
4) Post status updates to customers
5) Open provider escalation and monitor BGP adjacencies

Maya (Oncall Ops): Monitoring now — error rate dropped from ~15% to ~3% after steering. Latency increased ~40ms median for rerouted requests. Will keep oncall watch for 2 hours and update.

Anita (Support): Looping back to customers. Acme confirmed improvement when pinned to 2a. Tracking billing anomalies with Finance; no charge reversals yet.

PagerDuty: Provider reports progress — BGP adjacencies stabilized. Provider applied mitigations at 1769854540. We re-enabled us-west-2c pool weight at 1769854550.

Chris (SRE): Observability shows 5xxs returned to baseline and auth errors cleared. Closing incident but will follow up in postmortem. Action items: postmortem, provider follow-up, and customer billing check.

Anita (Support): Thanks all — customers updated and ticket closed on our side.

Sam (Acme - Customer): Appreciate the quick response and the region workaround.

Maya (Oncall Ops): Closing watch window. Will add notes to incident doc and schedule a short postmortem with NetInfra + SRE.

PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-1769854321 resolved at 1769854550.
